name: NEXUM
tag: Finds what is wrong on your network, explains it in plain words and proposes a fix you approve.

scenarios.title: Fix a slow office network
scenarios.ask: Staff at our {sites}-site office say the network is slow. We have about {devices} devices. Main complaint: {symptom}.
steps: Scanner
Found {=devices + round(devices * 0.08)} devices, {=round(devices * 0.08)} more than your inventory list, across {sites} sites.
Diagnostic agent
Ran speed, latency and channel tests. {=ceil(sites * 1.5)} access points share overlapping Wi-Fi channels.
Traffic agent
One backup job runs at {=8 + symptom} a.m. and uses about {=30 + symptom * 10}% of the uplink during work hours.
Resolver
Proposed new channel plans and moving the backup to 11 p.m. Waiting for your approval.
Verifier
After approval, re-runs the same tests and compares before and after.
followups: Does it change anything on its own?
No. The Resolver prepares the change and shows exactly what it will do. A person approves it, and every change can be rolled back from the log.
Usually personal phones, smart TVs or old printers. NEXUM lists each one with its maker and first-seen time so you can label or block it.
Will the scan slow things down?
The scan is light and spreads over a few minutes. For {devices} devices it usually finishes in about {=max(2, round(devices / 60))} minutes.

scenarios.title: Run a security hygiene sweep
scenarios.ask: Check our {devices} network devices for outdated firmware, default passwords and open ports. Our last review was {months} ago.
steps: Scanner
Fingerprinted {devices} devices and matched each to its maker and model.
Firmware agent
{=ceil(devices * min(0.6, 0.1 + months * 0.015))} devices run firmware older than the maker's current release.
Config agent
{=max(1, round(devices * 0.04))} devices still accept a default admin login.
Port agent
Found {=max(1, round(devices * 0.05))} devices with remote management open to the internet.
Resolver
Built a fix list ordered by risk, with the internet-facing items first.
followups: Can it update firmware for us?
It can stage updates for supported devices and run them in a window you pick. Each update needs approval, and it checks the device comes back healthy.
Is this a full security audit?
No. It covers network device hygiene. A full audit also looks at user accounts, laptops and cloud services.
How often should we run it?
Monthly is a good rhythm. NEXUM can run it on a schedule and only alert you when something new shows up.

scenarios.title: Plan the network for a new site
scenarios.ask: We are opening a new site for {users} people across {floors}. Plan the network before move-in.
steps: Planner
Sized Wi-Fi for {users} people at about {=2 + use} devices each, or {=users * (2 + use)} connections.
Layout agent
Placed {=max(floors, ceil(users / 25))} access points so each floor has coverage with overlap.
Segmenter
Split the network into staff, guest, cameras and building systems so a problem in one does not spread.
Bandwidth agent
Suggested an internet line of at least {=ceil(users * use * 2.5 / 50) * 50} Mbps with a backup line.
followups: It produces a parts list you can send to your supplier. Ordering stays with you.
The new site joins the same NEXUM dashboard, so scans and fixes work the same way as at your other sites.
